description: This Java source file defines a final class MutablePermissions implementing the Permissions interface. It provides a mutable, set-based implementation of Permissions, including methods for permission manipulation, JSON serialization, and predefined permission sets like none and all. The class is marked deprecated and not thread-safe, and it manages Permission objects within an EnumSet.
